since.description: A `snapshot_id` from an earlier get_window_state of the same window, or "latest" for this window's most recent read with the same query/max_elements/max_depth. Use it on every re-read after acting. Returns only what changed against that snapshot: `+` added rows, `~` changed rows, `-` removed rows (removed ids are the old snapshot's), or `no change`. Falls back to a full read when the snapshot is unknown, expired, belongs to another window, or was read with a different query/max_elements/max_depth; `since_status` says which. The response still carries a NEW snapshot_id and its element_tokens; rows not listed keep their previous [N] unless a `reindexed:` line says otherwise. Every tree read also returns the window's `ui_tree_revision`: it stays the same while reads of the same view see the same rows, and grows when they change. Pass it as `ui_tree_revision` on an action to have the action refused with `stale_revision`, before any input, when a later read saw the tree change.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for the accessibility-tree walk (default 1000, min 100, max 120000). Bounds the WHOLE walk. When the budget runs out the tool returns the PARTIAL tree it has, flagged with `truncated: true`, `truncation_reason`, `nodes_visited`, `nodes_pending` and `elements_complete: false`; retry with a larger value (e.g. 5000) or narrow with `query` / `max_depth`.

"both": the two together, as before; roughly doubles the size.

this wins over the saved default (`cursor.motion.*` in the driver config) and the
built-in `signature_arc`. Reduced motion always wins.

arc_flow.description:
Added to the arc asymmetry of `signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`:
positive moves the apex toward the destination. Clamped to -1..1 (default 0).

arc_size.description:
Scales the arc of `signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`: 0.25 (default)
keeps the style's arc, 0 is a straight line, 0.5 doubles it. Clamped to 0..1.

dwell_after_click_ms.description: Pause after a click animation, in milliseconds. Clamped to 0..5000 (default 80).

effects.description: Turn effects on or off. Omit a field to keep it; `"default"` restores the style default.

glow.description: Soft glow around the cursor that grows with speed.

magnet.description: Target glow when the `magnetic` style locks on.

ripple.description: Ring that expands from the hotspot on click.

squish.description: Brief scale-down of the cursor on click.

trail.description: Short fading trail behind the cursor.

end_handle.description:
Arc control-point offset from the end, as a fraction of the distance, for
`signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`. Clamped to 0..1 (default 0.3).

glide_duration_ms.description:
Move duration in milliseconds for `fixed` timing (1430 ms when 0, the default). A
nonzero value with `native` or the default `steady` timing also fixes the duration.
Clamped to 0..5000.

idle_hide_ms.description:
Hide the cursor after this many idle milliseconds; 0 never hides it. Clamped to
0..60000 (default 15000).

spring.description:
Arrival spring damping for `classic`: 1 is critically damped, 0.3 is bouncy. Clamped
to 0.3..1 (default 0.72).

start_handle.description:
Arc control-point offset from the start, as a fraction of the distance, for
`signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`. Clamped to 0..1 (default 0.3).

timing.description:
`steady` (default) keeps the style's timing but makes every move take at least 600 ms,
with a gentler ease; `relaxed` and `calm` do the same with a 450 or 750 ms floor.
`native` uses the style's own timing; `fitts` scales the move time with distance and
target size; `deliberate` is a slower Fitts curve (450..1300 ms); `fixed` uses
glide_duration_ms (1430 ms when 0).

turn_radius.description:
Minimum turning radius of the `classic` glide path, in points; smaller turns tighter.
Clamped to 1..1000 (default 80).

cursor_theme.description:
Optional initial cursor theme. The host applies it before the cursor is
first made visible, avoiding a flash of the default theme.

session.description:
Optional stable public label for this run (e.g. "research-run-1").
When omitted, the authenticated transport lease's implicit session is
created or returned.

delay_ms.description: Ms between characters in the CGEvent fallback. Default 0: characters go in batched key events, fast. Set a positive value for one paced key per character (debounced search boxes).

delivery_mode.description: Default "background": AX insert, then CGEvent keys, no focus steal. "foreground": front the window, type, restore; last resort for surfaces (WhatsApp/Catalyst) where background keys do not land.

element_token.description: Element handle `<snapshot_id>:<row>` from get_window_state: row `[11]` of snapshot s0000002a is "s0000002a:11".

post_action_wait.description: "none" returns without waiting up to 300 ms for a new window, menu, dialog or foreground change; a change seen later is reported on the next action's result.

scope.description: "desktop" with no pid/window_id types into the frontmost app.

session.description: For multi-call work, prefer a short public session label and repeat it on every call that accepts it.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

ui_tree_revision.description: The `ui_tree_revision` of the get_window_state read this action was planned from. The action is refused with `stale_revision`, before any input is delivered, when a later read of the same window saw the tree change or the driver has no revision for the window. It covers changes a read has observed: the driver does not watch the window between reads.

x.description: Screenshot-pixel X of the field (get_window_state PNG, as in click). With y and no element_token, pixel-clicks to focus, then types.

pid.description: Optional target pid. When omitted, the driver resolves the unique current snapshot for this session and window.

session.description: For multi-call work, prefer a short public session label and repeat it on every call that accepts it.

x1.description: Left edge of region in screenshot pixels.

x2.description: Right edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y1.description: Top edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y2.description: Bottom edge of region in screenshot pixels.
